title: schc_session: 24-bit replay counter + duplicate/conflicting tile semantics
description:
Parent project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.3.7.6 (spec/03-adaptation.md 5.6, authenticated bounded Zephyr SCHC session authority). Decomposed per Yegge's rule; this is one independently landable slice. Zephyr C in lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/ + host tests in lichen/tests/. Run host CMake tests on this Linux host (Attic toolchain absent; use local gcc/clang + cmake, ASan+UBSan per tests/cmake/test_common.cmake).

SLICE 4 (in-session fragment rules, depends on slices 1-3): carry the authenticated unsigned 24-bit link replay counter (Epoch<<N | SeqNum) into every transition; track the session-wide greatest counter under ordinary unsigned ordering (NO wrap; a counter at 0xffffff cannot be reused or wrapped under the same key). Duplicate vs conflict: an authenticated fragment repeating an already-stored tile coordinate with IDENTICAL bytes is an idempotent duplicate - discard without clearing/replacing/resetting any stored tile, but STILL advance the session high-water to the fresh counter. A repeated coordinate with DIFFERENT bytes MUST fail closed and MUST NOT reset the context into an attacker-selected partial packet. Session admission: only the canonical first Regular Fragment (W=0,FCN=62) with counter strictly greater than the durable admission floor opens a session; All-1/ACK-REQ/aborts/other FCN NEVER open a session; opening counter becomes the immutable session-admission floor. Unit tests: stale vs fresh counters, 0xffffff exhaustion (no wrap), idempotent duplicate, conflicting-tile fail-closed, non-opener FCNs rejected as session starts. LAND AFTER slices 1-3.
